name: IJM
recent: IJM 近期获得一份价值 RM1.23 bil 的合约，在吉打 Kulim 高科技园为 AT&S 兴建半导体制造设施。公司同时有多项董事与委员会人事变动，包括独立董事 Tan Ting Min 于 10 月 31 日卸任，Tan Beng Ling 获委任为独立非执行董事及审计委员会成员。EPF 与 KWAP 等大股东在 10 月至 11 月间持续有持股变动申报。
notable: 获得价值 RM1.23 bil 的合约，在吉打 Kulim 高科技园为 AT&S 兴建半导体制造设施。
Tan Beng Ling 获委任为独立非执行董事及审计委员会成员，2026 年 10 月 31 日生效。
Tan Ting Min 卸任独立非执行董事及提名与薪酬委员会主席，2026 年 10 月 31 日生效。
risks: 大股东 EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
KWAP 于 2026 年 10 月 20 日申报持股变动。
首席人力资源官 Jenney Kuan 在 9 月至 11 月间多次在公开市场交易公司股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM2,292.3 mil，按季增长 22.8%，按年增长 32.2%；净利为 RM148.4 mil，按年增长 38.4%，净利率为 6.5%。

recent_en: IJM recently secured a RM1.23 billion contract to build AT&S semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Kulim Hi-Tech Park, Kedah. The company also saw several board and committee changes, including the retirement of independent director Tan Ting Min effective 31 October and the appointment of Tan Beng Ling as independent non-executive director and audit committee member. Substantial shareholders including EPF and KWAP continued to file changes in their shareholdings between October and November.
notable_en: Secured a RM1.23 billion contract to build AT&S semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Kulim Hi-Tech Park, Kedah.
Tan Beng Ling was appointed as Independent Non-Executive Director and member of the Audit Committee, effective 31 October 2026.
Tan Ting Min ceased to be Independent Non-Executive Director and Chairman of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, effective 31 October 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder EPF filed multiple changes in its shareholdings between October and November.
KWAP filed a change in its shareholdings on 20 October 2026.
Chief Human Resources Officer Jenney Kuan traded the company's shares in the open market multiple times between September and November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2,292.3 million, up 22.8% QoQ and 32.2% YoY; net income was RM148.4 million, up 38.4% YoY, with a net margin of 6.5%.
